name: Caelestia Shell
summary: Quickshell-based desktop shell for Hyprland with dashboard, launcher and dynamic colors.
description: The desktop shell from the Caelestia dotfiles, built with Quickshell for Hyprland: bar, dashboard, launcher and colors generated from your wallpaper. This repository is the shell only; the complete dotfiles live in the main Caelestia repository. It is packaged in the AUR as caelestia-shell (stable) and caelestia-shell-git, and runs directly with Nix.
